item.title: Ci platform
item.description:
An abandoned continuous integration platform with a Go backend and a Vue single-page frontend. The source retains its job, pipeline, and project management components.

Links

  • Source code: https://github.com/alwaldend/src/tree/master/projects/ci_platform

Features

  • Clean architecture
  • Backend: Golang, Gorm, Fiber, Hcl, Postgresql
  • Frontend: SPA, VueJS with PrimeVue

Arch

Layout

ci_platform
├── api [Interface Adapters]
│   ├── controller
│   ├── middleware
│   └── presenter
├── cmd (CLI interface)
├── docs (OpenAPI Specification and other documentation)
│   └── diagrams
├── entity [Enterprise Business Rules]
├── infrastructure [Frameworks and Drivers]
│   ├── access
│   ├── branch
│   ├── config
│   ├── job
│   ├── jwt
│   ├── lifecycle
│   ├── pipeline
│   ├── pool
│   ├── project
│   ├── schedule
│   ├── session
│   └── user
├── pkg (Support packages)
│   └── error
└── usecase [Application Business Rules]
│   ├── access
│   ├── branch
│   ├── job
│   ├── jwt
│   ├── lifecycle
│   ├── pipeline
│   ├── pool
│   ├── project
│   ├── schedule
│   ├── session
│   └── user
└── web (Web interface)
